description: Get maintenance and troubleshooting guidance for a tank water heater based on its age and (optionally) symptoms such as popping/rumbling noises, running out of hot water, leaking, rusty water, or no hot water. General guidance, not a diagnosis or a quote. The $99 everyday flush price is mentioned only when sediment/flush guidance applies.

age_years.description: Age of the water heater in years (from the manufacture date on its label).

symptoms.description: Optional description of symptoms, e.g. 'popping noises and running out of hot water'.

name: water_heater_check
